title: Method, device and system for federal learning

pse.problem: High network transmission overhead and data security issues in existing federated learning systems
pse.solution_function: Federated server trains the model based on compressed updating gradients from clients, reducing network transmission overhead and improving system performance. Clients continue training their models using the received compressed global update gradient.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of federal servers and multiple clients, each with a neural network model. Clients have local data sets and are capable of obtaining gradients for model updates.
pse.solution_implementation: Clients send their updated gradients to the federal server which performs aggregation processing and singular value decomposition (SVD) to obtain a first global update gradient. Alternatively, clients send the last k layers' updated gradients of an initial p-layer structure model, where k > 0 and < p. The federal server aggregates these gradients to obtain a second global update gradient.
pse.effect: Reduced network transmission overhead leading to improved system performance. Enhanced data security by minimizing the visibility of individual client updates to the federated server.
